job.eternalrealm.knight.desc: Iron defender. +15% HP, stronger guard. Draws enemies away from allies.
job.eternalrealm.assassin.desc: Dual-blade killer. Higher critical chance and damage, cheaper dodges.
job.eternalrealm.mage.desc: Wields magic with a staff. +20% magic damage from a distance.
job.eternalrealm.ranger.desc: Master archer. +15% ranged damage and faster movement.
job.eternalrealm.priest.desc: Healer. +30% healing. Heals and blesses allies; holy light smites the undead.
job.eternalrealm.spellblade.desc: Swords infused with magic. Half of INT also powers physical attacks.
skill.eternalrealm.knight_shield_bash.de: Strikes ahead and slows enemies for 3 s.
skill.eternalrealm.knight_war_cry.desc: Taunts enemies within 12 blocks; takes 30% less damage for 8 s.
skill.eternalrealm.knight_iron_wall.desc: Shield of 30% max HP and 50% less damage; nearby allies take 20% less.
[Ultimate] Gathers power and smashes everything within 6 blocks.
Dashes forward and cuts enemies around the landing spot.
Three cuts; the last makes the target bleed for 5 s.
skill.eternalrealm.assassin_smoke_bomb.d: Turns invisible, speeds up and makes nearby enemies lose track of you.
skill.eternalrealm.assassin_thousand_bla: [Ultimate] Cuts everything around you ten times.
skill.eternalrealm.mage_fireball.desc: A fireball that explodes on impact and burns enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.mage_ice_lance.desc: A piercing lance of ice that freezes and slows enemies.
skill.eternalrealm.mage_thunderstorm.des: Lightning strikes up to 5 enemies within 12 blocks, twice.
skill.eternalrealm.mage_meteor.desc: [Ultimate] Calls a meteor down where you look: a huge explosion.
skill.eternalrealm.ranger_rapid_shot.des: Looses three arrows in quick succession.
skill.eternalrealm.ranger_spread_shot.de: Fires five arrows in a fan.
skill.eternalrealm.ranger_leap_shot.desc: Leaps back while firing a strong, slowing arrow.
skill.eternalrealm.ranger_arrow_rain.des: [Ultimate] Rains arrows on the area 10 blocks ahead.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_heal.desc: Heals you and allies within 8 blocks.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_holy_light.des: A bolt of holy light; double damage to the undead.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_blessing.desc: Allies within 10 blocks: +20% damage and regeneration for 10 s.
skill.eternalrealm.priest_sanctuary.desc: [Ultimate] Greatly heals and protects allies and smites nearby foes.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_arcane_edg: A slash wrapped in magic (magic damage).
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_flame_blad: For 10 s: +25% damage and melee hits set enemies on fire.
Sends a piercing wave of mana.
skill.eternalrealm.spellblade_dimension_: [Ultimate] Dashes in and cuts space itself, then again a moment later.
